controls.note: Authorization, consent, immutability, privacy and restriction rules are normative in spec/ and the plan.
The owner policy and the AI-assisted review role are recorded and SECURITY.md defines intake. No named human security owner or CODEOWNERS file exists; naming one is an owner decision.
CodeQL security-extended, npm audit (high), adversarial unit/DB tests, live ClamAV and browser axe runs in CI.
Seven operational gates; release:check exits non-zero until all are accepted with dated evidence.
Production and development Neon branches are separate; CI uses disposable databases only; production secrets live only in Render.
Workflows run least-privilege (contents: read except the registry sync). Branch protection on main is not configured; enabling it is a repository-settings decision for the owner.
Render auto-deploy is off; deploys are explicit from main and /api/health reports the exact deployed commit.
Originals are digest-bound and re-hashed by the archive audit; evidence tables are append-only.
SQL-proven actors, append-only triggers, digest-bound media, outbound SSRF controls, reviewed component/data-flow inventory.
AI-assisted design reviews are recorded; independent human design review remains pending follow-up (not a blocker under AGENTS.md).

Fixed in this assessment: the audit now runs on exactly the committed lockfile (npm ci) instead of re-resolving it; CI and the render worker install with npm ci; Dependabot proposes npm, Actions and base-image updates weekly.
Parameterized SQL, same-origin checks, bounded bodies, sanitized headers, constant-time token comparison.

Fixed in this assessment: lockfile-exact installs everywhere. Containers run as the unprivileged node user. Remaining: base images and Actions are pinned by version tag, not digest; Dependabot keeps them current.
Every change goes through a pull request with the full CI and AI-assisted review; required human review is not configured (owner policy allows merging without it).
Adversarial authorization, immutability, SSRF, malware and privacy cases on real PostgreSQL and Chromium in CI.
CSP and frame denial by default; fail-closed public origin in production; loopback webhooks only outside production; uploads blocked without a scanner.
Fixed in this assessment: SECURITY.md defines private reporting, response targets and scope. Enabling GitHub private vulnerability reporting is a repository setting for the owner.
Findings are fixed with tests in the review PRs; SECURITY.md sets response targets.
SECURITY.md requires a root-cause note and sibling search for every confirmed vulnerability.
